item.text:
{"answers":[{"question_id":"Q014_paper_example_reclassification_pa1492","answer":"PA1492 changed from a separate fold to a distinct family within the same superfamily as nucleoside 2-deoxyribosyltransferase.

In SCOP 1.69, PA1492 (1t1j) was classified as c.137.1.1, in its own “Hypothetical protein PA1492” fold (c.137; sunid 110459). Nucleoside 2-deoxyribosyltransferase (1f8y) was c.23.14.1, within the Flavodoxin-like fold (c.23). They therefore shared the alpha/beta class (c), but neither fold nor superfamily; that classification did not recognize their evolutionary relationship.

In the API’s current release, SCOPe 2.08, PA1492 is c.23.14.2, while 1f8y remains c.23.14.1. They now occupy different families in the same N-(deoxy)ribosyltransferase-like superfamily (c.23.14; sunid 52309), within the Flavodoxin-like fold (sunid 52171). This recognizes probable common ancestry, a stronger conclusion than structural resemblance at fold level, without merging them into one family.

PA1492’s chain-A domain retains sunid 106249, although its SID changed from d1t1ja_ to d1t1ja1 (residues 1–118); 1f8y’s chain-A domain is d1f8ya_ (sunid 31395). The reclassification does not by itself establish that PA1492 performs the same reaction or has the same substrate specificity as 1f8y; such functional transfer requires independent biochemical and active-site evidence.","evidence_used":["/api/v1/","/api/v1/releases/1.69/pdb/1t1j","/api/v1/releases/1.69/pdb/1f8y","/api/v1/releases/2.08/pdb/1t1j","/api/v1/releases/2.08/pdb/1f8y","/api/v1/releases/1.69/pdb/1t1j/domains","/api/v1/releases/1.69/pdb/1f8y/domains","/api/v1/releases/2.08/pdb/1t1j/domains","/api/v1/releases/2.08/pdb/1f8y/domains","/api/v1/releases/1.69/sunids/106249","/api/v1/releases/1.69/sunids/31395","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/106249","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/31395","/api/v1/releases/1.69/resolve/c.137.1.1","/api/v1/releases/2.08/resolve/c.23.14.2","/api/v1/releases/2.08/resolve/c.23.14.1","/api/v1/releases/2.08/resolve/c.23.14","/api/v1/releases/2.08/resolve/c.23","/api/v1/releases/1.69/sunids/110462","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/110462","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/52311","/api/v1/releases/1.69/resolve/c.137"]}]}
